The '''New Republic resistance''' was an underground movement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lazerian IV]]. The planet's monarchy was staunchly allied with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but a groundswell of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] sympathizers was steadily gaining ground within the [[Lazerian (people)|Lazerian]] class structure. The resistance numbered about 50,000 individuals, and was led by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Aereena]]. Few members of the resistance knew that the princess led them, and she played the spoiled princess while in public.
